# CampusVerify

> A credit-powered survey platform connecting researchers with verified university students and the general public for honest, campus-scoped responses.

CampusVerify helps students, professional researchers, organisations, and community respondents run and answer relevant surveys. Students sign up with an academic email and get campus-scoped feeds; General/Researcher users can conduct research or participate in public surveys. Non-partner students receive 10 permanent sign-up credits, General/Researcher accounts receive 5, and partner-school students receive 50. Credits are earned by answering and spent to publish.
